race.comment: WESTERN MISS (9) returned with a bang over 1400m, rounding them up to score as the $2.35 favourite. She ran to a solid level there and that looks a good platform to build on as she steps out to the mile. A new peak figure looks on the cards, and that'll make her very hard to hold out. DECORATION (2) got the job done at this track and trip last week, winning by 0.3L in a good performance. Nottle hops on board now and he maps to get every chance again. Should sit handy from the outset and can repeat the dose without surprising. I DREAMED A DREAM (8) bolted in at Kalgoorlie two back before a 1.8L defeat over 1800m here last start. Back to the mile now doesn't look an issue and if he gets some luck from the draw, he'll be right in the finish. HOLLER NUFF (4) can improve second-up and out to the mile. REDBACK FLYER (5) has been disappointing this campaign, but he's a different horse when third-up and at the mile. Blinkers going on adds interest.
